findings.claim: Cadence 10-Q: no single customer accounted for 10% or more of total revenue in the three and six months ended June 30, 2026 or June 30, 2025; and as of June 30, 2026 and December 31, 2025 no single customer accounted for 10% or more of total receivables. The 10-Q text fetched shows no disclosure of a named customer moving to a second EDA supplier or taking the tools in-house.
findings.source: Cadence Design Systems Form 10-Q for quarter ended 2026-06-30 (StockTitan filing page: https://www.stocktitan.net/sec-filings/CDNS/10-q-cadence-design-systems-inc-quarterly-earnings-report-8a625afc5b99.html)

customer_second_source.note: No sourced, dated evidence found of any specific customer adding a second EDA supplier or taking EDA in-house. Search summaries carried some undated commentary (for example, in-house ASIC design team growth being positive for Cadence and Synopsys, and systems companies at about 45% of demand). Those were not confirmed against a dated primary source, so they are not recorded as findings. The as_of is the 10-Q period end. The exact filing date was not confirmed in the fetch. The Pandaily article on Chinese EDA vendors (Aug 2026) came back headline-only, so any China domestic-substitution angle is unverified.
